Rooms.Name: The Reading Room
Rooms.Description:
You are in a small, simple room which is mostly empty, save a few
wooden desks and benches. To the east you hear the bustle of the
Temple of Midgaard, a sharp contrast to the relative quiet of this
peaceful room.

Exits.Description: You see the Temple of Midgaard.

You see a light shimmering across the archway, which seems to hold
something inside the room.  You are guessing noise.

Rooms.Name: The Temple Of Midgaard
Rooms.Description:
You are in the southern end of the temple hall in the Temple of
Midgaard.  The temple has been constructed from giant marble blocks,
eternal in appearance, and most of the walls are covered by ancient
wall paintings picturing Gods, Giants and peasants. Large steps lead
down through the grand temple gate, descending the huge mound upon
which the temple is built and ends on the temple square below. To the
west, you see the Reading Room. The donation room is in a small
alcove to your east. There is a note for the newbies here.
#rType look note to read note.#N

Exits.Description: At the northern end of the temple hall is a statue and a huge altar.

In the east, you see a small alcove with a rickety wooden sign which
reads "Midgaard Donation Room."
You look down the huge stone steps at the temple square below.
There is a stairway going up that leads to a Bot room
Stairs lead down to the Catacombs

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The note says:

Welcome to Elite!

For the rules, type :

   policy

For some info, type :

   info

To move in any directions you type the direction.

example to move west you type :
  west

To talk to other players you use say.

  say Hi

More info about this in the Halls of learning

Directions:

   two west then north.

You will also get some free equipment there.

Rooms.Name: Cleric's Inner Sanctum
Rooms.Description:
This is the inner sanctum. A picture of the mighty Thor, is
hanging on the wall, just above the altar which is set against the
western wall. A well in the middle of the floor leads down into
darkness. Vile smells waft from the depths.

Exits.Description: You see your favorite place, the bar of divination.

You can't see what is down there, it is too dark. Looks like it would be
impossible to climb back up.

Rooms.Name: Cleric's Bar
Rooms.Description:
The bar is one of the finest in the land, lucky it is members
only. Fine furniture is set all around the room. A small sign is
hanging on the wall.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The sign reads:
Free instructions provided by the waiter:

   Buy  - Buy something (drinkable) from the waiter.
   List - The waiter will show you all the different drinks and
          specialties, and tell the price of each.

Rooms.Name: Entrance to Cleric's Guild
Rooms.Description:
The entrance hall is a small modest room, reflecting the true
nature of the Clerics. The exit leads east to the temple square. A
small entrance to the bar is in the northern wall.

Exits.Description: You see the bar, richly decorated with really stylish furniture.

Rooms.Name: The Temple Square
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on the temple square. Huge marble steps lead up
to the temple gate. The entrance to the Clerics Guild is to the west,
and the old Three Crowns Inn, is to the east. Just south of here you
see the market square, the center of Midgaard.

Rooms.Name: Entrance Hall of the Three Crowns Inn
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in the entrance hall of the Three Crowns Inn. The
hall has been wisely decorated with simple, functional furniture. The
heavy smell of dust and aging paper drifts in from the Post Office to
the north. A small staircase leads up to the reception and the bar is
to the east.

Exits.Description: You see the Midgaard Post Office.

Rooms.Name: The Three Crowns
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in the bar. The bar is set against the northern
wall, old archaic writing, carvings and symbols cover its top. A
fireplace is built into the western wall, and through the
southeastern windows you can see the temple square. This place makes
you feel like home. A small sign with big letters is fastened to the
bar.

Exits.Description: You see the exit to the entrance hall.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Although it is very hard to understand, you think it looks a lot like
beer,
poems about beer, and small beer-mugs.

The sign reads:
Free instructions provided by the Three Crowns Inn.

   Buy  - Buy something (drinkable) from the bartender.
   List - The bartender will show you all the different drinks and
          specialties, and tell the price of each.

Rooms.Name: The Reception
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in the reception. The staircase leads down to the
entrance hall. An exit to the north leads to the Cryogenic Center.
There is a small sign on the counter.

Exits.Description: Wispy fog crawls out of the room to the north.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
*******************************
                *                             *
                *    This is a no rent MUD    *
                *      so theres no need      *
                *    to pay money to store    *
                *     your equipment, just    *
                *       save and quit!        *
                *                             *
                *******************************

Rooms.Name: The Bakery
Rooms.Description:
You are standing inside the small bakery. A sweet scent of Danish
and fine bread fills the room. The bread and Danish are arranged in
fine order on the shelves, and seem to be of the finest quality. A
small sign is on the counter.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Free instructions provided by the store:

   Buy  - Will buy you some bread or pastry.
   List - The baker will kindly tell you the price and sort of the bread
in
          his bakery.

You see that this is truly delicious pastry.  Must be made by a Dane
from Denmark (which surely is not the capital of Sweden!).  Former
ruler of Scandinavia, England, Northern Germany, Northern France,
Russia, Greenland, Iceland, Estonia etc.  etc.
   The sight of those large, wholesome chokoladeboller makes your
mouth water and your soul sing.

Rooms.Name: The General Store
Rooms.Description:
You are inside the general store. All sorts of items are stacked
on shelves behind the counter, safely out of your reach. A small note
hangs on the wall.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The note reads:

  List  - Show which various items are in the store.
  Buy   - Buy an item.
  Value - The shopkeeper will (free of charge) tell how much he will
          pay for your item.
  Sell  - Sell an item.

Rooms.Name: The Weapon Shop
Rooms.Description: You are inside the weapon shop. There is a small note on the counter.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The note reads:

  List  - Show which various items are in the store.
  Buy   - Buy an item.
  Value - The shopkeeper will (free of charge) tell how much he will
          pay for your item.
  Sell  - Sell an item.

Rooms.Name: Main Street
Rooms.Description:
You are at the end of the main street of Midgaard. South of here
is the entrance to the Guild of Magic Users. The street continues
east towards the market square. The magic shop is to the north and to
the west is the city gate.

Exits.Description: You see the entrance to the Guild of Magic Users.

Rooms.Name: Main Street
Rooms.Description:
You are on the main street passing through the City of Midgaard.
South of here is the entrance to the Armory, and the bakery is to the
north. East of here is the market square.

Rooms.Name: Market Square
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on the market square, the famous Square of
Midgaard. A large, peculiar looking statue is standing in the middle
of the square. Roads lead in every direction, north to the temple
square, south to the common square, east and westbound is the main
street.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
What you see is the Midgaard Worm, stretching around the Palace of
Midgaard.

Rooms.Name: The Main Street
Rooms.Description:
You are on the main street crossing through town. To the north you
can see the General store, and the main street continues east. To the
west you see and hear the market place, to the south a small door
leads into the Pet Shop.

Rooms.Name: The Main Street
Rooms.Description:
The main street, to the north is the weapon shop and to the south
is the Guild of Swordsmen. To the east you leave town and to the west
the street leads to the market square.

Exits.Description: You see the main street leading to the market square.

Rooms.Name: Entrance to Mage's Guild
Rooms.Description: The entrance hall is a small, poorly lit room.

Exits.Description: You see your favorite place, the Mage's Bar.

Rooms.Name: Mage's Bar
Rooms.Description:
The bar is one of the weirdest in the land. Mystical images float
around the air. Illusions of fine furniture appear all around the
room.

Rooms.Name: Mage's Laboratory
Rooms.Description:
This is the Magical Experiments Laboratory. Dark smoke-stained
stones arch over numerous huge oaken tables, most of these cluttered
with strange- looking pipes and flasks. The floor is covered with
half-erased pentagrams and even weirder symbols, and a blackboard in
a dark corner has only been partially cleaned, some painful-looking
letters faintly visible. A well in the middle of the floor leads down
into darkness. Vile smells waft from the depths.

Rooms.Name: The Armory
Rooms.Description:
The armory with all kinds of armors on the walls and in the
window. You see helmets, shields and chain mails. To the north is the
main street. On the wall is a small note.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You can use these commands for trading:

  value <item>     To get the price of an item in your possession.
  sell <item>      To sell something.
  buy <item>       To buy something (provided that the shop has it in
store).
  list             Gives you a listing of the shop's inventory.

        WE DON'T GIVE CREDIT; WE DON'T EXPECT TO RECEIVE CREDIT!
                             NO HAGGLING

Rooms.Name: Entrance Hall to the Guild of Swordsmen
Rooms.Description:
The entrance hall to the Guild of Swordsmen. A place where one has
to be careful not to say something wrong (or right). To the east is
the bar and to the north is the main street.

Exits.Description: You see the swordsmen's bar, many noises comes from there.

Rooms.Name: The Bar of Swordsmen
Rooms.Description:
The bar of swordsmen, once upon a time beautifully furnished. But
now the furniture is all around you in small pieces. To the south is
the yard, and to the west is the entrance hall.

Exits.Description: You see the entrance hall to the swordsmens guild.

Rooms.Name: The Tournament and Practice Yard
Rooms.Description:
The practice yard of the fighters. To the north is the bar. A well
leads down into darkness.

Exits.Description:
You can't see what is down there, it is too dark. Looks like it would be
impossible to climb back up.

Rooms.Name: Eastern End of Poor Alley
Rooms.Description:
You are at the poor alley. South of here is the Grubby Inn and to
the east you see common square. The alley continues further west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The sparkling circle seems to be some sort of rift. Trough it you see
a swirling haze, occasionally parting to reveal a strange and alien
landscape under a hostile gray sky.  The loud crackling noise that
the circle's spark cause convinces you that trying to squeeze through
it could be perilous.

Rooms.Name: The Common Square
Rooms.Description:
The common square, people pass you, talking to each other. To the
west is the poor alley and to the east is the dark alley. To the
north, this square is connected to the market square. From the south
you notice a nasty smell.

Exits.Description: You see a ruined city wall.

Rooms.Name: The Dark Alley
Rooms.Description:
You stand in an east/west running dark alleyway.  To the west is the
Common Square, while to the east, the alley continues on slightly better
lit. The shadows seem to collect to the north and south.  Peering to the
south, you see the infamous Midgaard Guild of Thieves.  Here, the shadows
gather where some people seem to sneak in and out.

Exits.Description: You see the entrance to the thieves guild.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The small black metal plaque is impervious to all damage, but seems
to bear a message on it anyways: #Y

This is the site of the Ancient Clan of Shadowblade, whom were the
watchers for the return of the Old Ones.  When the Ancient Unholy
Pact was broken in recent times, the Old Ones came back to repossess
Midgaard.  In a final fight, Shadowblades were able to seal the
entrance and inscribe an Elder Sign on the wall, preventing further
incursion to this realm.  As the pact was broken, a new one needed
forging at a cost of great sacrifice to the members, hence, Clan
Shadowblade was disolved with the members cursed to wander Elite, yet
always remember what they had.#N

As you look at the seal, you notice it's made up of several varrying
shapes that continue to change even when you are looking at it.  It
seems to be etched on a freshly sealed door (bricked up with the
mortar just dried).  On more closely examining the wall, you sense a
hand in magic on it.  The chaotic motion of the seal captivated your
attention, but now you notice a small adamantine plaque marked below
it.

It is the thieves guild, don't enter if you care about your health or
money.

Rooms.Name: Entrance Hall to the Guild of Thieves
Rooms.Description:
The entrance hall to the thieves' and assassins' guild. A place
where you can lose both your life and your money, if you are not
careful. To the north is the dark alley and to the east is the
thieves' bar.

Exits.Description: You see the thieves bar, where everything disappears.

Rooms.Name: The Thieves Bar
Rooms.Description:
The bar of the thieves. Once upon a time this place was
beautifully furnished, but now it seems almost empty. To the south is
the yard, and to the west is the entrance hall. (Maybe the furniture
has been stolen?!)

Exits.Description: You see the entrance hall to the thieves guild.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: As you look at the furniture, the chair you sit on disappears.

Rooms.Name: The Secret Yard
Rooms.Description:
The secret practice yard of thieves and assassins. To the north is
the bar.  A well leads down into darkness.

Exits.Description:
You can't see what is down there, it is too dark. Looks like it would be
impossible to climb back up.

Rooms.Name: The Dump
Rooms.Description:
The dump, where the people from the city drop their garbage. Through
the garbage you can see a large junction of pipes, looks like the
entrance to the sewer system, and to the north is the common square.
There is a sign posted here warning that anything dropped, becomes part
of the Midgaard reclamation project -- "YOU DROP IT, YOU LOSE IT FOR
GOOD!  All deposit, no return (or reimbursement)."

Exits.Description: You see a ruined city wall.

Rooms.Name: The Pet Shop
Rooms.Description:
The Pet Shop is a small crowded store, full of cages and animals
of various sizes. There is a sign on the wall.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The sign reads:

  Use 'List' to see the available pets.
  Use 'Buy <pet>' to buy yourself a pet.

  Instructions for having pets:

  You can use 'order <pet> <instructions>' to order your pets around.
  If you abuse your pet, it will no longer regard you as its master.
  If you have several pets you may use 'order followers <instructions>'

  You can name the pet you buy as : "buy <pet> <name>"

 Regards,
.
 The Shopkeeper

Rooms.Name: Pet Shop Store
Rooms.Description:
This is the small dark room in which the Pet shop keeps his pets.
It is vital that this room's virtual number is exactly one larger
than the Pet Shop number.

Rooms.Name: The Magic Shop
Rooms.Description:
Behind the counter you see various items, neatly placed in racks,
presumably most of them are magic.

Rooms.Name: Inside the West Gate of Midgaard
Rooms.Description:
You are by two small towers that have been built into the city
wall and connected with a footbridge across the heavy wooden gate.
Main Street leads east and Wall Road leads south from here.

Exits.Description:
You see the road running along the inner side of the city wall. You
notice that it is called Wall Road.
The city gate is to the west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It is built from large gray rocks that have been fastened to each
other with some kind of mortar.  It is far too high to climb.

Both of the towers are built from large gray rocks that have been
fastened to each other with some kind of mortar, just like the city
wall.

It is a set of very big double doors made from hard wood.  They have been
reinforced with large iron bands to make them even more sturdy.  One of
the doors is equipped with a very big lock.

It is too high up to reach but it looks as if one easily could walk
across it from one tower to the other.

Rooms.Name: Inside the East Gate of Midgaard
Rooms.Description:
You are by two small towers that have been built into the city
wall and connected with a footbridge across the heavy wooden gate.
Main Street leads west from here. To the south you see the Water
Shop.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It is built from large gray rocks that have been fastened to each
other with some kind of mortar.  It is far too high to climb.

Both of the towers are built from large gray rocks that have been
fastened to each other with some kind of mortar, just like the city
wall.

It is a set of very big double doors made from hard wood.  They have
been reinforced with large iron bands to make them even more sturdy.
One of the doors is equipped with a very big lock.

It is too high up to reach but it looks as if one easily could walk
across it from one tower to the other.

Rooms.Name: Wall Road
Rooms.Description:
You are walking next to the western city wall. The road continues
further south and the city gate is just north of here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It is built from large gray rocks that have been fastened to each
other with some kind of mortar.  It is far too high to climb.

Rooms.Name: Wall Road
Rooms.Description:
You are walking next to the western city wall. Wall Road continues
further north and south. A small, poor alley leads east. Some letters
have been written on the wall here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It is built from large gray rocks that have been fastened to each
other with some kind of mortar.  It is far too high to climb.
It says 'Who watches the watchmen?'

Rooms.Name: Poor Alley
Rooms.Description:
You are in the poor alley, which continues further east. You see
the city wall to the west.

Rooms.Name: Alley at Levee
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in the alley which continues east and west. South
of here you see the levee.

Rooms.Name: Eastern end of Alley
Rooms.Description:
You are standing at the eastern end of the alley, the city wall is
just east, blocking any further movement. A small warehouse is
directly south of here and a mexican food stand has been set up north
of here.

Rooms.Name: Wall Road
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on the road next to the western city wall, which
continues north. South of here is a bridge across the river.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It is built from large gray rocks that have been fastened to each
other with some kind of mortar.  It is far too high to climb.

Rooms.Name: Grubby Inn
Rooms.Description:
You are inside the old Grubby Inn. This place has not been cleaned
for several decades; vile smells make you dizzy.

Rooms.Name: Levee
Rooms.Description:
You are at the levee. South of here you see the river gently
flowing west.  The river bank is very low making it possible to enter
the river.

Exits.Description: You see the river flowing west.

Rooms.Name: Warehouse
Rooms.Description:
You are inside the warehouse. The room is decorated with various
old items from ships.

Rooms.Name: On the Bridge
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on the stone bridge crosses the river. The bridge
is built out from the western city wall and the river flows west
through an opening in the wall ten feet below the bridge.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It is built from large gray rocks that have been fastened to each
other with some kind of mortar.  It is far too high to climb.
You cannot really see it from here as it is somewhere beneath your feet.

It is built from large gray rocks that have been fastened to each
other with some kind of mortar, just like the wall.

Rooms.Name: Outside the West Gate of Midgaard
Rooms.Description:
You are by two small towers that have been built into the city
wall and connected with a footbridge across the heavy wooden gate. To
the west you can see the edge of a big forest.

Exits.Description: The city gate is to the east.
The forest edge is to the west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It is built from large gray rocks that have been fastened to each other
with some kind of mortar.  It is far too high to climb.

Both of the towers are built from large gray rocks that have been
fastened to each other with some kind of mortar, just like the city wall.

It is a set of very big double doors made from hard wood.  They have been
reinforced with large iron bands to make them even more sturdy.  One of
the doors is equipped with a very big lock.

It is too high up to reach but it looks as if one easily could walk
across it from one tower to the other.

Rooms.Name: Outside the East Gate of Midgaard
Rooms.Description:
You are by two small towers that have been built into the city
wall and connected with a footbridge across the heavy wooden gate. To
the east the plains stretch out in the distance.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It is built from large gray rocks that have been fastened to each other
with some kind of mortar.  It is far too high to climb.

Both of the towers are built from large gray rocks that have been
fastened to each other with some kind of mortar, just like the city wall.

It is a set of very big double doors made from hard wood.  They have been
reinforced with large iron bands to make them even more sturdy.  One of
the doors is equipped with a very big lock.

It is too high up to reach but it looks as if one easily could walk
across it from one tower to the other.

Rooms.Name: By the Temple Altar
Rooms.Description:
You are by the temple altar in the northern end of the Temple Of
Midgaard, A huge altar made from white polished marble is standing in
front of you and behind it are two ten foot tall statues of IO and
Rigel, the two Creators of the whole world. To the north, steps lead
out the back of the temple towards the countryside. To the south you
can see the temple of midgaard and up you can see the door (perhaps
rather disc, it floats up in the air) to the realms of Rigel.

Exits.Description: You see the vast Midgaard countryside.
You see the southern end of the temple.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The statue represents the one-eyed Odin sitting on a his throne.  He has
long, gray hair and beard and a strict look on his face.  On top of the
throne, just above his shoulders, his two ravens Hugin and Munin are
sitting and at his feet are his wolves Gere and Freke.

Even though the altar is more than ten feet long it appears to be made
from a single block of white virgin marble.

Rooms.Name: Odin's Store
Rooms.Description:
This is the small dark room in which Odin keeps the player items
that he takes care of. It is vital that this room's virtual number is
exactly one larger than the room by the temple altar.

Rooms.Name: Uncle Juan's Eatery
Rooms.Description:
This place makes your nose run just from the smell of the spicy
food they sell. Spicy as it may be it still looks very tasty. A box
of taco shells is set on the counter. There is a large, friendly sign
hanging on the wall here.

Exits.Description: You see the eastern end of alley.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It is a hand-written sign with large, friendly letters which say
"If it ain't Uncle Juan's, it ain't any good!"

Rooms.Name: Ye Olde Water Shoppe
Rooms.Description:
You are in Wally's World O' Water, whose proprietor, Wally, is
sure to have something to meet all of your water needs.

Rooms.Name: Behind the Temple Altar
Rooms.Description:
You are on a dirt path leading away from the Temple Altar which is
south of here. To the north, the path continues through the lush
countryside of Midgaard.

Exits.Description: You see the lush, green countryside of Midgaard.

Rooms.Name: The Great Field of Midgaard
Rooms.Description:
You are walking on a wide dirt path through the lush, green, fresh
Midgaard countryside. You can see to the horizon to the north, east,
and west; to busy city of Midgaard lies to the south. All around you
is healthy green grass and an occasional large oak tree. The sun
feels wonderful on your face and a pleasant wind blows through your
hair. Birds chirp quietly to themselves and you can smell the faint
scent of flowers and freshly cut grass. You feel like you could lie
down in the grass and stay here forever, surrounded by powerful
beauty in all directions. The path you are on continues north through
the field and south back to Midgaard.

Exits.Description: You see more of the path through the Great Field.
You see the path which goes back to Midgaard.

Rooms.Name: Clara's Field o' Daisies
Rooms.Description:
There a wide expanse of daisies as far as you can possibly see.
There are lazy bees, butterflies, and lady bugs flying about the
flowers. In the center of the field there is a humongous old tree,
inviting and friendly, begging you to nap beneath it. Its branches
filled with sweet singing birds, and a bee hive dripping with fresh
warm honey. As you look closely at the trunk of the tree, you notice
that it is shaped like a woman with arms reaching for the sky, the
warm sun... a lithe form with long, flowing hair and a filmy dress;
her eyes gazing always upwards, a smile playing about her lips -
Clara.

Exits.Description: You see more of the Field.

Rooms.Name: The Post Office
Rooms.Description:
You are in the central post office for Midgaard. Piles of assorted
mail lay untouched in the corners, collecting cobwebs. Several large
crates have been pried open by curious customs agents, and are now
stacked along the west wall, hiding plenty of 'WANTED' posters. There
is a sign posted on the wall here.

Exits.Description: You see the entrance to the Three Crowns Inn and Tavern.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Faces of various known Killers and Thieves can barely be seen behind the
crates on the west wall.  Some of them look quite familiar, sorta like
that guy who you saw in the Reception a minute ago...but then again, they
are rather hard to see past the crates.

As you know, it is illegal to send contraband items through the Midgaard
mail. The custom's agents use this as a great excuse to seize liquor,
rare spices, and just about anything they might find useful or
profitable.
They seem to cover everything here, even the Postmaster himself.

**********************************************************
*                                                        *
*    Mail Instructions :                                 *
*                                                        *
*      To send a note to someone :                       *
*         MAIL <playername> <next name> ...              *
*                                                        *
*      To post a postcard to someone :                   *
*         POST <cardname> <playername> <next name> ...   *
*                                                        *
*      To see if you have any mail :                     *
*         CHECK                                          *
*                                                        *
*      To get the Postmaster to give you your mail :     *
*         RECEIVE                                        *
*                                                        *
*         Stamps cost 350 coins per letter               *
*         Type 'HELP MAIL' for more info                 *
**********************************************************

Rooms.Name: Midgaard Donation Room
Rooms.Description:
You are in a small, undecorated room just off of the main temple.
There are a couple of small wooden benches here where people
occasionally sit while they wait for items to appear. The temple is
to the west.

Exits.Description: The busy temple is back west.

Rooms.Name: The Cryogenic Center
Rooms.Description:
The walls of this room are covered with frosty patterns, and the
floor is slippery with ice. On one side of the room is a wide cage,
and all around the room are coffin-shaped containers apparently made
of bronze. A faintly glowing sign just next to the entrance might be
worth reading.

Exits.Description: The Reception is to the south.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Each one contains a perfectly preserved adventurer, just waiting to
be thawed out before going adventuring again. Peering into the tiny
crytal window in the top of the container to notice the occupant is
particularly ugly, but hey - they can't all be as beautiful as you!
How amusing, Amok has written his name in the snow.

It says 'The cryo-shopkeeper works just like any other shopkeeper
just type list to see what he can do!'

Note, when you buy cryo, your character is protected against pfile
purges for six months after you log out. BUT, you are automatically
and permanently thawed out when you log back- effectively cancelling
the cryo.

Rooms.Name: Wall Road
Rooms.Description:
You are standing at the end of Wall Road. To the east is Temple
Street.

Rooms.Name: West Temple Street
Rooms.Description:
You are on West Temple Street. The city library is to the north,
perhaps you should go there and learn more about the lands round
about. To the south you can see a tailor sewing on the porch of his
shop.

Rooms.Name: West Temple Street
Rooms.Description:
You are on West Temple Street. You can see Clerics and Paladins
entering the guild to the north, and a fine jeweler displays his
wares to the south. To the east you see the ever busy Temple Square.

Rooms.Name: East Temple Street
Rooms.Description:
You are on East Temple Street. Temple square is to the west and
stores and other buildings are on each side. Your nose is assaulted
by the pungent smell of flowers from the store to the south, mixed
with the aroma of bitters from the pub to the north.

Rooms.Name: East Temple Street
Rooms.Description:
You are on East Temple Street. You see a lot of activity around
the building to the north. Lot's of people are eager to lose their
coins in the gambling hall. The building to the south is has a quill
pen and ink bottle for a sign.

Rooms.Name: East Temple Street
Rooms.Description:
You have reached the East end of East Temple Street. To the south
you can see the East gate of the city. Northward there is a bank. To
the west you can see people walking along Temple Street to visit the
various merchants.There is a faint portal to the east with an odd
triangle engraved on it.

Rooms.Name: Tailor's
Rooms.Description:
You have entered a tailor's shop, bright and colorful garments are
here on display. You can probably find clothing here for any
important occasion. Like that wedding you heard about for this
weekend...

Rooms.Name: Jeweler's
Rooms.Description:
You have entered a Jeweler's Shop, tasteful racks have carefully
arranged jewelry and gems for sale. I am sure you can find that
special gift for that special person in your life here. Remember:
Diamonds are forever!

Rooms.Name: Rosy's Flowers
Rooms.Description:
This is a florist shop. Beautiful roses adorn the shelves in
tasteful arrangements. You are nearly overwhelmed by the smell of
growing things. Isn't there someone whose day you could brighten with
a thoughtful gift?

Rooms.Name: Stationary Shop
Rooms.Description:
Fine Stationary is on display here. Writing implements are also
available.  Why don't you pick up a supply and practice your
spelling!

Rooms.Name: City Bank
Rooms.Description:
This is the city bank. In the interests of security all
transactions are now handled by computer. The clerks got tired of
being attacked by newbies.

Rooms.Name: The Casino
Rooms.Description:
Gambling of all types is available here. Try some blackjack,
roulette, craps, or if you are a real player, go downstairs for some
poker!

Exits.Description: The poker palace is downstairs, hmm maybe you could double your money.

Rooms.Name: City Library
Rooms.Description:
This building has a long hallway running north and south.  Each
cubby has a different board of information. On the west side (in
order of closest to farthest) is the Mortal board, Quest board, and
Skills & Spells board.  On the east side (in order of closest to
farthest) is the Social board, remort board, and Area board.  The
entire building is silent and you are expected to be too.  Please no
spamming in here and post only what the room states is acceptable
please.  In general, no hateful postings or vulgar language please,
or the posting will be removed.  Thank you.

Rooms.Name: Roulette Room
Rooms.Description:
This room only contains a large roulette table. There is a sign on
the wall.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
HOW TO PLAY:
> BET <AMOUNT> <SLOT> - where slot is 0-36, LOW, MID, HIGH, RED or BLUE
> BET LIST - lists all your bets
> LOOK TABLE
Bets must be between 1000-100000

Rooms.Name: The Old South Gate
Rooms.Description:
The ruins of the old south gate stand here.  This gate has been
unused and unguarded for years now, and has fallen into a state of
disrepair.  Moss grows everywhere, eating into rock, and parts of the
wall have crumbled off.  A small sign points south, with the word
"Dump" written on it.  You hear the bustle of peasants to the north.

Rooms.Name: City Library: East->Social Board/West->Mortal Board
Rooms.Description:
This is a long hallway which starts in the south at the entrance
and runs the length of the building.  You see little reading rooms to
the east and west. Each has it's own purpose.

Exits.Description:
You see in the distance, the Social board used for player social
announcements.

You see in the distance, the Mortal board used for discussions with
Elite's gods.

Rooms.Name: City Library: East -> Remort Board/West-> Quest Board
Rooms.Description:
This is a long hallway which starts in the south at the entrance
and runs the length of the building.  You see little reading rooms to
the east and west.  Each has it's own purpose.

Exits.Description:
You see in the distance, the Remort board used for discussing Remort
policies and information.

You see in the distance, the Quest board used for announcing upcomming
quests and past results.  It is usefull for discussing quests.

Rooms.Name: City Library: East->Area board/West->Skills&Spells board
Rooms.Description:
This is a long hallway which starts in the south at the entrance
and runs the length of the building.  You see little reading rooms to
the east and west.  Each has it's own purpose.

Exits.Description:
You see in the distance, the Area board used for discussing areas, mob,
equipment, and such with the gods and other players.  Hints, but not
actual directions or solutions can be given here as well.

You see in the distance, the Skills and spells board used for
discussing the character related parts of the game with the other
players and the gods (new ideas, comments, etc).

Rooms.Name: City Library: Area Board
Rooms.Description:
You are by the Area board which contains information about areas.
Please post only things relating to areas on this board, such as
hints on areas, level information, comments on areas, ideas for new
areas and mob, etc.  Thank you -- Midguaard Librarian --

Exits.Description: You see the main hallway of the Midgaard Library.

Rooms.Name: City Library: Skills and Spells Board
Rooms.Description:
You are by the spells and skills board which contains information
about character spells and skills. Please post only things relating
to character abilities here, which includes spells and skills
corrections, ideas, comments, and character classes and races.
Thank you -- Midgaard Librarian --

Exits.Description: You see the main hallway of the Midgaard Library.

Rooms.Name: City Library: Quest Board
Rooms.Description:
You are by the Quest board which contains information about
quests. Please post only things related to quests here on this board.
This includes such information as quest results, comments, ideas,
suggestions, etc.  Thank you -- Midgaard Librarian --

Exits.Description: You see the main hallway of the Midgaard Library.

Rooms.Name: City Library: Remort Board
Rooms.Description:
You are by the Remort board which contains information about
remorting.  This is mostly an informational board, but comments and
questions about remorting can be posted on this board.  Thank you --
Midgaard Librarian --

Exits.Description: You see the main hallway of the Midgaard Library.

Rooms.Name: City Library: Social Board
Rooms.Description:
You are by the social board which contains general social
information for this mud.  This includes wedding and divorce
announcement, social announcements, character announcements, clan
information not clan specific, taunts, teases, and other things
related to the general social aspects as you might see in a society
page of your local newspaper.  This can include special events too.
With the exception of clan questions, please do not use this board as
a serious message board as far as asking the Immortals any thing in
general.  That is found on the Mortal board 2 west of here.  Thank
you -- Midgaard Librarian --

Exits.Description: You see the main hallway of Midgaard's library.

Rooms.Name: City Library: Mortal Board
Rooms.Description:
You are by the Mortal board which is for general information and
posts which is passed between the mortals and Immortals on this mud.
This includes such things as general questions and comments about the
mud, it's operation, or anything specific to it's operation (shy of
code).  This also is for anything not covered in any of the other
boards.  In general, a way of discussing things with the gods of
Elite.  Thank you -- Midgaard Librarian --

Exits.Description: You see the main hallway to the Midgaard Library.

Rooms.Name: Midgaard Chat room
Rooms.Description:
You are in a slightly noisy room.  The noise is caused from
several conversations going on at once.  This is a no magic room as
the talking is cause for more then enough spam, thank you very much,
and you should bring a supply of food and drink here.  Willful
spamming of this room is cause for removal.  Repeated offenses will
lead to jailing.

Exits.Description:
You see a slight shimmering across the archway holding back the flood of
sound.

Rooms.Name: City Library: East->Clan Board
Rooms.Description:
This is a long hallway which starts in the south at the entrance
and runs the length of the building.  You see a little reading room
to the east.

Rooms.Name: City Library: Clan Board
Rooms.Description:
You are by the Clan Board which contains information dealing with
the offical clans and their structure as a whole (Not for a clan to
promote or discuss clan business or to degrade another clan).  If you
have questions, comments, or other official postings dealing with
clans (as a whole), then post them here. (Do not ask about individual
clans here either.)

Rooms.Name: Bot Storage Room
Rooms.Description:
This is where all the bots go when they are left on unattended.
By going up, you go to the temple.  If a bot is caught automatically
going up and back to a bot room or clan house, they will be put here
and frozen until such a time that the player talks to an Imm capable
of unfreezing the PC.

Exits.Description: This path leads you to the temple.

Rooms.Name: Temple stairs
Rooms.Description:
This is a magic room that was constructed by the mightiest remorts
of the mud.  After waves of violence struck Midgaard when the avatars
could not enter the guilds, their most powerful wizards constructed
this portal into the guilds.  You see light shining in from above.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This is the non-clan Bot room.  Please use or have your clan place its
Bots inside of your clan house.

Rooms.Name: BOT Room
Rooms.Description:
You are in a special room up in the temple which has been set
aside for Bots, those mystical automatons which make life simple.
Please park them here and there is a max of 2.  If you are in a clan,
please go to a clan bot room

Exits.Description: There is a stair here going down.

Rooms.Name: The Poker Room
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in the Midgaard Poker Room. It is a smelly,
smokefilled room with many tables. There are decks of cards
everywhere. Why don't you settle down with some friends and play
their shirts off? There's a sign here with the title: HOW TO PLAY?

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
*************************************************************************
*
                          GENERIC CARD GAME BY IO

        Appoint one player as dealer.  Everyone else follow him/her.
        The dealer can:
        GET CARDS               - get a new deck of cards. or get all the
                                  cards back from the players.
        DEAL <player> #         - deal # number of cards to player.
        DEAL ALL #              - deal # number of cards to all players.
                                  i.e. dealer and all followers.
        SHUFFLE CARDS           - shuffles the deck.

        All players can:
        LOOK CARDS              - Look at your own hand.
        DISPLAY CARDS           - Show others in room your cards.
        DROP CARDS # # # ...    - Drops cards (Back to dealer's deck)
                                  ex: > drop ca 3 2 5
                                  will drop the second, third and fifth
card.
                                  or: > drop ca all
        SORT CARDS              - Sort the cards in your hand.
        SWITCH CARDS # #        - Will switch two cards in your hand.
                                  i.e. for putting your aces together.

        System newly made and will certainly have bugs.
*************************************************************************
*

Mobs.Name: wizard mage
Mobs.LongDescription: A Wizard walks around behind the counter, muttering to himself.
Mobs.Description:
The wizard looks old and senile, and yet he looks like a very powerful
wizard. He is equipped with fine clothing, and is wearing many fine 
rings and bracelets.

Mobs.Name: baker
Mobs.LongDescription:
The Baker looks at you calmly, wiping flour from his face with one 
hand.
Mobs.Description:
A fat, nice looking baker. But you can see that he has many scars on 
his body.

Mobs.Name: grocer
Mobs.LongDescription:
A grocer stands at the counter, with a slightly impatient look on his 
face.
Mobs.Description:
A tall grocer, who moves two 200 pounds bag of flour around on his 
shoulders.

Mobs.Name: weaponsmith
Mobs.LongDescription:
A weaponsmith is standing here, eager to sell you his tools for 
carnage and destruction.
Mobs.Description:
He's a young weaponsmith, who still has lots to learn.  But it look like 
he can use his weapons as well as sell them.

Mobs.Name: armorer
Mobs.LongDescription:
An Armorer stands here displaying his shiny new (and previously 
owned) armors.
Mobs.Description:
An old but very strong armorer.  He has made more armors in his 
life than you have ever seen.

Mobs.Name: receptionist
Mobs.LongDescription: A receptionist is standing behind the counter here, smiling at you.
Mobs.Description:
You notice a tired look in her face.  She looks like she isn't paid well 
enough to put up with any crap from mud players with attitudes.

Mobs.Name: captain
Mobs.LongDescription: A retired Captain stands here, selling boats.
Mobs.Description: This Captain has eaten more sharks than you have killed peas.

Mobs.Name: sailor
Mobs.LongDescription: A Sailor stands here, waiting to help you.
Mobs.Description: He looks like a strong, fit sailor.

Mobs.Name: uncle juan
Mobs.LongDescription: Uncle Juan is here ready to take your order.
Mobs.Description: He looks like he may or may not have a green card.

Mobs.Name: wally watermaster
Mobs.LongDescription:
Wally the Watermaster is standing behind the counter, proudly 
displaying his fine collection of contemporary waters.
Mobs.Description:
Wally is a bit pudgy but looks very strong.  He has a glass of 
Midgaard Natural Spring Water in his hand.

Mobs.Name: postmaster post master
Mobs.LongDescription:
The head Postmaster is standing here, waiting to help you with your 
mail.
Mobs.Description:
The Postmaster seems like a happy old man, though a bit sluggish.  
He worries about the reputation of the EMS (Elite Mail Service), as many 
people seem to think that it's slow.  Perhaps if he were to brush the 
cobwebs from his uniform it'd help to make a better impression.

Mobs.Name: ice drakes icedrakes
Mobs.LongDescription: A dozen ice-drakes squabble over tasty diamond treats.
Mobs.Description:
Ice drakes are the secret of gnomish cryogenics. Feeding the ice drakes 
with diamonds and sapphires allows them to get up enough chilling power 
to keep people deep frozen, giving them hugely extended lifetimes. The
ice drakes are around two feet in length, and covered in blue, silver 
and white scales. A crest of ice runs down their backs, and they snort 
little icy clouds which seem to cling to the ground.

Mobs.Name: priest cleric healer
Mobs.LongDescription: The Priest is standing here, offering his services.
Mobs.Description: The priest is young and healthy.  His purse looks full and heavy.

Mobs.Name: harold undertaker
Mobs.LongDescription: Harold the Undertaker is here selling coffins.
Mobs.Description:
Harold is tall, skinny and black and has a very shrill voice.  He walks 
around with a long stick, used as both walking stick and to messure 
peoples height.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%10 puke;%10 snicker;%20 snore;%90 spit;%40 giggle;%50 addict;%90 
bkiss;%10 wave

Mobs.Name: guildmaster master
Mobs.LongDescription: Your guildmaster is standing here.
Mobs.Description:
Even though your guildmaster looks old and tired, you can clearly 
see the vast amount of knowledge she possesses.  She is wearing fine 
magic clothing, and you notice that she is surrounded by a blue 
shimmering aura.

Mobs.Name: guildmaster master
Mobs.LongDescription: Your guildmaster is standing here.

Mobs.Name: guildmaster master
Mobs.LongDescription: Your guildmaster is standing here.
Mobs.Description:
You realize that whenever your guildmaster moves, you fail to notice 
it - the way of the true thief.  She is to be dressed in poor clothing, 
having the appearance of a beggar.

Mobs.Name: guildmaster master
Mobs.LongDescription: Your guildmaster is standing here.
Mobs.Description:
This is your master. Big and strong with bulging muscles. Several 
scars across his body proves that he was using arms before you were 
born. He has a calm look on his face.

Mobs.Name: sorcerer guildg
Mobs.LongDescription: A sorcerer is guarding the entrance.
Mobs.Description:
He is an experienced mage who has specialized in the field of Combat 
Magic.  He is here to guard the Mage's Guild and his superior knowledge 
of offensive as well as defensive spells make him a deadly opponent.

Mobs.Name: knight templar guildg
Mobs.LongDescription: A knight templar is guarding the entrance.
Mobs.Description:
He is a specially trained warrior belonging to the military order of 
the Faith.  His duty is to protect the faithful from persecution and 
infidel attacks and his religious devotion combined with his superior 
skill makes him a deadly opponent.

Mobs.Name: assassin guildg
Mobs.LongDescription: An assassin is guarding the entrance.
Mobs.Description:
He is a thief who has specialized in killing others as effectively as 
possible, using all sorts of weapons.  His superior knowledge of how and 
where to use them combined with his extraordinary stealth makes him a 
deadly opponent.

Mobs.Name: knight guildg
Mobs.LongDescription: A knight is guarding the entrance.
Mobs.Description:
He is an expert warrior who has attained knighthood through 
countless chivalrous deeds.  His duty is to protect the Guild of 
Swordsmen and his extreme skill combined with his experience in warfare 
makes him a deadly opponent.

Mobs.Name: tailor
Mobs.LongDescription: A Tailor is sitting here, making new garments.
Mobs.Description:
Everywhere on his garments, there are needles and thread in every 
color. He seems busy with sewing a new dress, but is looking at you 
suspiciously, muttering, 'Don't touch anything with those filthy hands!'

Mobs.Name: jeweler
Mobs.LongDescription: A Jeweler is standing behind his counter, displaying his goods.
Mobs.Description:
He is wearing rings on each of his fingers, and amulets with 
diamonds and gold hangs around his neck. He looks at you witha wry 
smile, saying, 'Welcome wealthy citizens!'

Mobs.Name: rosy
Mobs.LongDescription: Rosy is here with her hands in a pot, replanting some flowers.
Mobs.Description:
Rosy is a midaged woman with her long hair braided. Dirt patches 
adorn her simple dress, as if she uses it to clean her hands now and 
then. She smiles when she sees you and asks, 'What will it be today?'

Mobs.Name: merchant
Mobs.LongDescription: The merchant stands here, displaying his fine white paper.
Mobs.Description:
The merchant looks stern. He is properly dressed and looks up from 
his writing as you enter. 'How can I help you?' he asks.

Mobs.Name: waiter
Mobs.LongDescription:
A man who in his young days was a famous sorcerer but now leads a 
quiet, peaceful life as a waiter.

Mobs.Name: waiter
Mobs.LongDescription: A waiter who seems to have reach contact with God.

Mobs.Name: waiter
Mobs.LongDescription: A waiter who knows where all his customers have their money.

Mobs.Name: waiter
Mobs.LongDescription:
A waiter is here who looks like he could easily kill you while still 
carrying quite a few firebreathers.

Mobs.Name: filthy
Mobs.LongDescription: Filthy is standing here, eager to serve you a special drink.
Mobs.Description:
Filthy looks real, ehm, dirty.  He likes to keep his costumers happy,
but do not mess with him or else he'll get upset.

Mobs.Name: keeper peacekeeper
Mobs.LongDescription:
A Peacekeeper is standing here, ready to jump in at the first sign of 
trouble.
Mobs.Description: He looks very strong and wise.  Looks like he doesn't answer to ANYONE.

Mobs.Name: cityguard guard
Mobs.LongDescription: A cityguard stands here.
Mobs.Description: A big, strong, helpful, trustworthy guard.

Mobs.Name: janitor
Mobs.LongDescription: A janitor is walking around, cleaning up.

Mobs.Name: fido dog
Mobs.LongDescription: A beastly fido is mucking through the garbage looking for food here.
Mobs.Description:
The fido is a small dog that has a foul smell and pieces of rotted meat 
hanging around his teeth.

Mobs.Name: mercenary merc
Mobs.LongDescription: A mercenary is waiting for a job here.
Mobs.Description: He looks pretty mean, and you imagine he'd do anything for money.

Mobs.Name: drunk
Mobs.LongDescription: A singing, happy Drunk.
Mobs.Description: A drunk who seems to be too happy, and to carry too much money.

Mobs.Name: beggar
Mobs.LongDescription: A beggar is here, asking for a few coins.
Mobs.Description: The beggar looks like she is fed up with life.

Mobs.Name: odif yltsaeb
Mobs.LongDescription: An odif yltsaeb is here, walking backwards.
Mobs.Description: The odif is a small god that has been reversed by some dog.

Mobs.Name: cityguard guard
Mobs.LongDescription: A Cityguard is here, guarding the gate.
Mobs.Description: A big, strong, helpful, trustworthy guard.

Mobs.Name: green gelatinous blob
Mobs.LongDescription: An oozing green gelatinous blob is here, sucking in bits of debris.
Mobs.Description: A horrid looking thing; it's huge, greenish, and looks like the blob.

Mobs.Name: rufus paper boy
Mobs.LongDescription: Rufus the paper boy is here, shouting about the local news.
Mobs.Description:
Rufus was recently hired by the Midgaard News service to advertise the
local newspaper.  Since most peasants (that's you) can read, it's a good
way to get the information in your world out and about.  He snaps at you
to type "NEWS" (all capital letters) to find out what's up!
Mobs.ActionScript: %%1 say Extra, extra, read all about it!;%1 say Type NEWS for all the news that's fit to print!

Mobs.Name: kitten
Mobs.LongDescription: A small loyal kitten is here.
Mobs.Description: The kitten looks like a cute, little, fierce fighter.

Mobs.Name: puppy
Mobs.LongDescription: A small loyal puppy is here.
Mobs.Description: The puppy looks like a cute, little, fierce fighter.

Mobs.Name: beagle
Mobs.LongDescription: A small, quick, loyal beagle is here.
Mobs.Description: The beagle looks like a fierce fighter.

Mobs.Name: rottweiler
Mobs.LongDescription: A large, loyal rottweiler is here.
Mobs.Description: The rottweiler looks like a strong, fierce fighter.

Mobs.Name: wolf
Mobs.LongDescription: A large, trained wolf is here.
Mobs.Description: The wolf looks like a strong, fearless fighter.

Mobs.Name: cryogenicist cryo gnomish gnome
Mobs.LongDescription: A gnomish cryogenicist stands here, feeding his ice-drakes.
Mobs.Description:
The wizened little gnome is wrapped head to toe in thick yak-skin 
garments. He is constantly slipping the dozen ice-drakes crunchy diamond 
and sapphire treats, and they snort chilly clouds of appreciation which 
crawl along the floor.

Mobs.Name: questeq shopkeeper
Mobs.LongDescription: A Quest equipment shopkeeper
Mobs.Description:
He is an old man, but you should still not take him for granted, after all,
he is the shopkeeper of the quest eq, and he probably knows how to make the
best of the equipment he is selling.

Mobs.Name: horse mount
Mobs.LongDescription: A horse is standing here.
Mobs.Description: This looks like a normal horse.

Objects.Name: rose red
Objects.Description: A red rose is lying on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: This is no ordinary rose, as it is a gift from IO.

Objects.Name: rose pink
Objects.Description: A beautiful pink rose is lying on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: This is no ordinary rose. It is a gift from IO.

Objects.Name: rose yellow
Objects.Description: A bright yellow rose is lying on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: This is no ordinary rose. It is a gift from IO as a token of friendship.

Objects.Name: rose white
Objects.Description: A frosty white rose is lying on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: This is no ordinary rose. It is a gift from IO as a token of eternal trust.

Objects.Name: rose black
Objects.Description: An ill-boding black rose is lying on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: This is no ordinary rose. It is a sign from IO.  Death is always near.

Objects.Name: rose blue
Objects.Description: An blue rose is lying on the ground.

Objects.Name: wedding ring
Objects.Description: A plain golden ring is lying here.

Objects.Name: tuxedo
Objects.Description: A newly ironed tuxedo is lying here.

Objects.Name: wedding dress
Objects.Description: A long white gorgeous wedding dress in neatly folded here.

Objects.Name: pen quill
Objects.Description: A quill pen has been dropped here.

Objects.Name: paper
Objects.Description: A sheet of paper lies here.

Objects.Name: spray can spraycan
Objects.Description: a spraycan of a weird color lies here.

Objects.Name: ring wisdom iq
Objects.ShortDescription: a ring of wisdom and high IQ
Objects.Description: A plain metal ring, with an F in it, has been left here.

Objects.Name: Veil
Objects.Description:
A beautiful bride's veil, made of the finest lace, has been left
here.

Objects.Name: Slippers
Objects.Description:
A sparkling pair of glass slippers, once worn by a bride, has been
left  here.

Objects.Name: Corsage
Objects.Description:
A wedding corsage crafted of the most delicate and rare flowers has
been left here.

Objects.Name: Gloves
Objects.Description: A beautiful pair of white lace gloves has been left here.

Objects.Name: Trousers
Objects.ShortDescription: A pair of black leather trousers
Objects.Description:
A pair of black leather trousers, made of finest calfskin, has been
left here.

Objects.Name: Boots
Objects.ShortDescription: A pair of high leather boots
Objects.Description:
A pair of high leather boots, styled in the latest fashion, has been
left here.

Objects.Name: Boutonierre
Objects.Description:
A wedding boutonierre made of the finest red roses has been left
here.

Objects.Name: backpack back pack
Objects.Description: A backpack lies here.

Objects.Name: water cup
Objects.Description: A cup has been set here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It is a large simple cup.

Objects.Name: water bottle
Objects.Description: A bottle of Evian natural spring water is here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You've been ripped off!  It says here at the bottom of the label, in really
really small letters, "Bottled in the Midgaard branch of Evian Inc.  This
water is from the natural, mostly clean River of Midgaard."
It is a large, clean bottle.

Objects.Name: water canteen
Objects.Description: A canteen has been set on the ground here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It's a fairly big canteen.  Looks like it can hold a lot of liquid.

Objects.Name: ale bottle dark
Objects.Description: A dark bottle of ale has been left here.

Objects.Name: firebreather bottle
Objects.Description: A firebreather has been left here.

Objects.Name: local bottle
Objects.Description: A dark bottle has been left here.

Objects.Name: vodka bottle
Objects.Description: A transparent bottle is standing here.

Objects.Name: burek
Objects.Description: A delicious burek taunts you with its mouth watering smell.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It's made from the finest pastry and the tastiest cheese. It' still
piping hot from the bakers oven.

You start to drool.

Objects.Name: bread
Objects.Description: A loaf of bread has been left here.

Objects.Name: danish pastry
Objects.Description: A nice looking delicious danish pastry has been placed here.

Objects.Name: taco mexican
Objects.Description: A tasty looking Mexican taco has been dropped here.

Objects.Name: burrito hot
Objects.Description: A spicy looking burrito has been set here.

Objects.Name: nachos nacho
Objects.Description: Some nachos have been left here.
Objects.ActionDescription: They have cheese on them.  Looks like one of Uncle Juan's specials.

Objects.Name: meat chunk
Objects.Description: A rather dubious looking piece of meat is on the ground here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It's not so much that the meat looks poisoned or anything, but that you
just are not sure of it's origins.  You doubt that a hunter would drop a
side of venison or rabbit meat... what in the world could this meat have
come from, you wonder...

Objects.Name: dagger
Objects.Description: A dagger with a long thin blade is here.

Objects.Name: sword small
Objects.Description: A small sword lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The small sword seems to have an inscription of some sort inscription...
It says: "May this sword be a good companion."

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
There is a small note on the machine which says:

To use, type "BALANCE", "WITHDRAW x", or "DEPOSIT x".  Please report any
strange occurrences to the bank manager.

Objects.Name: fountain water
Objects.Description: A large fountain carved from blue-streaked marble is here, bubbling merrily.
Objects.ActionDescription:
It is a well crafted fountain, carved from a single piece of marble.  It seems
to be enchanted in some manner, as the water level seems to never lower.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It is very beautiful white marble, shot through with electric blue streaks
that look almost like lightning dancing along the sides of the fountain.
